rules.name: Generic / Common Name of Commodity
rules.description: The generic or common name of the commodity contained in the package must be prominently declared on the principal display panel.
rules.recommendation_template: Prominently print the unambiguous generic or common name of the product on the principal display panel.

rules.name: Net Quantity in Standard Metric Units
rules.description: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight (g/kg), volume (ml/l), length (cm/m), or count (number/units) must be declared without prohibited qualifiers.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b), Rule 12 & Rule 13, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.recommendation_template: Declare exact net quantity using standard metric units (e.g. 100 g, 500 ml, 1 kg) without words like 'approx' or 'when packed'.

rules.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
rules.description: The retail sale price of the package must be clearly stated in Indian Rupees as Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes.
rules.recommendation_template: Declare MRP clearly with currency symbol and mandatory phrasing: 'MRP ₹... (inclusive of all taxes)'.

rules.name: Unit Sale Price (USP) Declaration
rules.description: For packages containing more than 1 kg or 1 litre, unit sale price per gram/kg/ml/litre or per unit must be declared alongside MRP.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(f) (as amended 2021), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules
rules.recommendation_template: Declare unit sale price in ₹ per gram/ml/piece (e.g. ₹0.20 / g or ₹15.00 / 100 ml) for packages where applicable.

rules.name: Manufacturer / Packer Name and Complete Address
rules.description: The name and complete physical address of the manufacturer or pre-packer including city, state, and postal PIN code must be stated.
rules.recommendation_template: Provide complete manufacturer name and physical postal address with city, state, and 6-digit PIN code.

rules.name: Consumer Care & Grievance Redressal Details
rules.description: Name, designation, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
rules.recommendation_template: Provide consumer grievance contact with designation (e.g. Consumer Care Cell), toll-free phone/telephone, email ID, and postal address.

rules.name: Country of Origin Declaration
rules.description: The country of origin or manufacture must be explicitly declared on every packaged commodity (e.g., 'Country of Origin: India').
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(10) & Rule 6(1)(m), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.recommendation_template: Explicitly state 'Country of Origin: [Country Name]' or 'Made in [Country Name]'.

rules.name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Pre-packing
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed must be clearly stated on the label.
rules.recommendation_template: Print month and year of manufacture or packaging in clear numeric or word format (e.g. '08/2026' or 'Aug 2026').

rules.name: Batch / Lot Identification Number
rules.description: A batch number, lot number, or code number distinguishing the commodity package for quality and recall tracking.
rules.recommendation_template: Print lot or batch code (e.g. 'Batch No: B240801' or 'Lot: LK-99').

rules.name: Importer Details for Foreign Goods
rules.description: If the commodity is imported into India, the complete name and address of the importer must be declared.
rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) & Rule 23, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.recommendation_template: For imported goods, declare full importer name, registered address in India, and import registration.

rules.name: Best Before / Expiry Date Declaration
rules.description: Food, beverage, and perishable packages must declare 'Best Before' or 'Expiry Date' with day/month/year or number of months from packing.
rules.recommendation_template: Declare 'Best Before: XX months from packaging' or 'Expiry Date: DD/MM/YYYY'.

rules.name: Veg / Non-Veg Logo & Category Declarations
rules.description: Packaged food products must clearly display the mandatory Vegetarian (Green dot in green square) or Non-Vegetarian logo.
rules.legal_reference: FSSAI (Packaging and Labelling) & Legal Metrology Rule 6
rules.recommendation_template: Display the statutory Vegetarian or Non-Vegetarian emblem prominently on the display panel.
